title: PrecogUI: Proactive GUI Agents via Pre-cognitive Simulation and Experience Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2609.36923v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing reactive Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents often fail in long-horizon, dynamic scenarios, where unexpected disturbances trigger attention-diverting and cascading failures. To address this, we propose PrecogUI, a pre-cognitive architecture that shifts the paradigm from reactive execution to proactive decision-making. Specifically, we design a Proactive Experience Pool (PEP), which caches recurring anomaly and success patterns as "state-action-result" tuples in a dual-memory repository. Furthermore, we introduce a Proactive Simulation Executor (PSE) that learns to forecast the next symbolic UI layout given a candidate action, enabling early anomaly avoidance and ranking candidate actions by predicted reliability. Finally, a Pre-cognitive Execution Controller (PEC) fuses these priors and predictions, prioritizes handling of foreseen anomalies, and ensures execution robustness through a closed-loop error correction mechanism. translated_title: PrecogUI：基于预认知模拟与经验检索的主动式GUI智能体
translated_abstract: 现有的被动响应式图形用户界面（GUI）智能体在长时程、动态场景中常常失败，因为意外的干扰会引发注意力分散和级联式故障。为解决这一问题，我们提出PrecogUI，一种将范式从被动执行转变为主动决策的预认知架构。具体而言，我们设计了主动经验池（PEP），将反复出现的异常和成功模式以“状态-动作-结果”元组的形式缓存到双重记忆库中。此外，我们引入了主动模拟执行器（PSE），它学习在给定候选动作时预测下一个符号化UI布局，从而实现早期异常规避，并根据预测可靠性对候选动作进行排序。最后，预认知执行控制器（PEC）融合这些先验知识与预测结果，优先处理可预见的异常，并通过闭环纠错机制确保执行的鲁棒性。
tldr: PrecogUI通过预认知模拟与经验检索，将GUI智能体从被动响应转变为主动决策，提前预测并规避异常，显著提升了长时程动态场景下的执行鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: PrecogUI shifts GUI agents from reactive execution to proactive decision-making via pre-cognitive simulation and experience retrieval, enabling early anomaly avoidance and robust execution in long-horizon dynamic scenarios.
